item.title: ABE Board Review — Restoration of the Endodontically Treated Tooth — June 8, 2026
item.description: Episode 37. Restoring the endodontically treated tooth: why these teeth fracture (loss of structure, not dehydration — Sedgley and Messer 1992; Reeh, Messer and Douglas 1989), the ferrule effect (Sorensen and Engelman 1990), the truth that posts only retain cores rather than strengthen teeth, and the case for cuspal coverage of posterior teeth (Aquilino and Caplan 2002).

item.title: ABE Board Review — Root Canal Sealers — June 8, 2026
item.description: Episode 36. Root canal sealers: Grossman's requirements for an ideal sealer, and the major chemistries — zinc oxide eugenol, calcium hydroxide, epoxy resin (AH 26 and AH Plus), glass ionomer, silicone, and the modern calcium silicate bioceramic sealers that enable single-cone obturation but resist retreatment.

item.title: ABE Board Review — Obturation Techniques — June 8, 2026
item.description: Episode 35. Obturation techniques compared: cold lateral compaction and its vertical-root-fracture risk, Schilder's warm vertical compaction, Buchanan's continuous wave, Johnson's 1978 carrier-based Thermafil, and the modern single-cone bioceramic approach — with the outcome evidence (Peng 2007) showing disinfection, not technique, drives healing.

item.title: ABE Board Review — Principles of Obturation and Gutta-Percha — June 8, 2026
item.description: Episode 34. The principles of obturation and gutta-percha: Schilder's 1967 three-dimensional definition, the three goals of obturation, gutta-percha composition and the beta-to-alpha phase change, the apical limit debate (Kuttler 1955; Sjögren 1990), and the critical role of the coronal seal established by Ray and Trope 1995.

item.title: ABE Board Review — Calcium Hydroxide Intracanal Medicament — June 1, 2026
item.description: Episode 33. Calcium hydroxide as an intracanal medicament: Hermann's 1920 introduction, the high-pH hydroxyl-ion mechanism, inactivation of lipopolysaccharide (Safavi and Nichols), the classic Byström 1985 and Sjögren 1991 disinfection studies, Enterococcus faecalis resistance via proton pump (Evans 2002), effects on dentin strength, and the role in apexification.

item.title: ABE Board Review — Smear Layer, EDTA, and Final Irrigation — June 1, 2026

item.title: ABE Board Review — Root Canal Irrigants: Sodium Hypochlorite — June 1, 2026

item.title: ABE Board Review — Canal Preparation Techniques — June 1, 2026
item.description: Episode 30. Cleaning and shaping principles: Schilder's five mechanical objectives (1974), crown-down versus step-back, the balanced force technique (Roane 1985), anticurvature filing and the danger zone (Abou-Rass 1980), the glide path, the apical preparation size debate (Card 2002), procedural errors, and reciprocation versus continuous rotation.
